name: NeuroFlow

acquisitions.notes: Acquired to create largest end-to-end behavioral health measurement and engagement platform

short_description: Enterprise behavioral health measurement and engagement platform supporting 17M+ lives. Features 400+ assessments, AI-powered risk detection, population analytics, and BHIQ data platform.
long_description: NeuroFlow is the leading enterprise behavioral health technology platform combining measurement-based care, patient engagement, and population health analytics. Following the June 2024 acquisition of Owl Insights, NeuroFlow created the largest end-to-end behavioral health measurement and engagement platform. The platform supports over 17 million lives across 300+ health systems, payers, and employers in all 50 states. Key features include 400+ behavioral health assessments in multiple languages, automated bi-directional EHR integration (Epic, Cerner, Athenahealth), AI/NLP-powered risk detection including suicidal ideation screening, and BHIQ - a behavioral health analytics layer aggregating claims, EMR, pharmacy, and consumer data. NeuroFlow's mobile app drives patient engagement between visits with psychoeducational content and daily check-ins.
one_liner: Enterprise MBC platform supporting 17M+ lives with 400+ assessments and population analytics.
best_for: Health systems integrating behavioral health into primary care
Payers managing population behavioral health risk
Large integrated delivery networks needing behavioral health analytics
Organizations seeking AI-powered suicide risk detection
Employers implementing scalable behavioral health programs
not_for: Solo practitioners or small group practices
Organizations seeking simple standalone assessment tools

pricing.notes: Enterprise pricing based on population size and deployment scope. Contact NeuroFlow for custom quote. Typical deployments serve health systems, payers, and large employers.
